heading, Expert healthcare at your fingertips, level 1

Oviva supports you every step of the way to achieve your long-term weight goals. We provide effective weight-loss medication to jump start your journey. Our comprehensive programme and app help you learn how to maintain it for good.
Discover how Oviva can help you and register for free today.
end of link, Get started for free
image, Group of three people enjoying a healthy meal together at a wooden dining table.
heading, Your health is our priority, level 2

Oviva offers a weight loss programme available on the NHS led by experienced doctors. It lasts 6-24 months, depending on your preferences and eligibility for medications. The programme covers everything from your eating habits and mental health, to your exercise routine and nutritional needs.
Decide with your coach which weight loss option best suits you, your life and your goals.
On average, participants that take weight loss medications on our programme lose 13.6kg.
We will closely support you with a personalised dietary approach and plan to help you meet your goals.

heading, 3 ways Oviva helps you, level 2
heading, 1. Your Oviva coaching team, level 3
Our experienced team includes dietitians, doctors, nurses and psychological practitioners. Psychology support is focused on developing healthy behaviours—not treating mental health conditions.
We understand everyone has different needs. We’ll consider everything, including your medication and health, to ensure your treatment is safe and effective.

Track your progress, set individual goals with your coach, and learn about nutrition and health with the Oviva app. Our app makes it easy to record your meals and activities, even when life gets busy, provides personalised recommendations to help you improve your diet.
image, Oviva App Screens Meal logging
Easily log your meals with the photo diary in the Oviva app – a simple way to keep track of what you’re eating.
Your health coach will help you set the right personal goals that bring you closer to your feel-good weight.
With your unique goals set, the Oviva app has all the tracking you need to work towards them with ease.
image, Oviva App Screens learn content
With learning content on nutrition, exercise, and motivation, you’ll become a weight-loss expert yourself.
image, Oviva App Chat with Coach
et 1-to-1 support from a health coach and chat with our nutrition experts anytime via the Oviva app.
Getting to know yourself better is one of the keys to a healthy life. With Oviva you can access helpful guides on everything from eating right, staying active, and building healthy habits.
Every step counts: Discover why your body needs exercise. Weekly goals, quick tips, videos, and podcasts will keep you motivated.
Our learning content helps you gradually adopt new healthy habits and change unwanted patterns of behaviour in small, manageable steps.
Lose weight with the foods you love: It’s possible by making the right choices. Discover why counting calories isn’t always very effective and why it’s important to focus on balance instead.
Contact your GP to check whether you are eligible for a referral.

Schedule your first appointment with one of our doctors or specialist nurses to go through your options. If eligible, and that is your preference, your weight loss medications will be discretely delivered to your door. Download the Oviva app, get started with tracking and speak to your healthcare team through the Oviva app at times that suit you best.

You will receive regular support with the Oviva healthcare team to help you manage your new healthy habits or weight loss medication, depending on which option you have chosen. The Oviva app will guide you through each step, enabling you to track your progress and drive long term behaviour change. Learn how to transform your eating habits for lasting health benefits. Get ready to feel more energised, active, and confident!

With the ongoing encouragement from your coach, start embracing healthier daily routines that will help keep the weight off long after you stop your weight loss medication. Our dedicated team will be by your side each step of the way to provide comprehensive guidance and support.
